radio.title: Does birth order matter?
radio.text: For many years, people believed that the first child in a family would be more responsible and the youngest more creative. If that were true, we could predict a lot about people from their position in the family. However, recent large studies have found only very small differences. Researchers say that if earlier studies had included more families, they might have reached the same conclusion.
